title: Self Join
seoDescription: Use a SQL self join to pair users with their referrers while labeling organic signups without a referral.
description:
Join a table to itself on foreign key `referrer_id`, labeling unreferred signups as Organic.

$$
\text{Users } u \operatorname{LEFT JOIN} \text{ Users } r \text{ ON } u.\text{referrer\_id} = r.\text{user\_id}
$$

Given input parameters `users`, return list of records containing user_id, username, and referrer_name.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
def sql_self_join(users: list) -> list:
    umap = {u['user_id']: u['username'] for u in users}
    res = [{'user_id': u['user_id'], 'username': u['username'], 'referrer_name': umap.get(u.get('referrer_id'), 'Organic')} for u in users]
    res.sort(key=lambda x: x['user_id'])
    return res
```
